references.title: Short Proofs Are Narrow — Resolution Made Simple
references.source: Journal of the ACM 48(2); ECCC TR99-022
references.note: Relates Resolution width and size and yields exponential general-Resolution lower bounds for explicit expander-based formulas, supplying the lower-bound half of the H048 refutation.

references.title: Extending CDCL to Disjunctions of Parity Equations
references.note: Defines CDCL over linear clauses and establishes a bidirectional polynomial connection with Res(XOR), motivating the parity-enhanced descendant of H048 and its matching lower-bound target.

references.title: Limits of CDCL Learning via Merge Resolution
references.note: Studies proof systems generated by standard CDCL learning and the polynomial relationship with Resolution, supporting the conflict-to-proof transfer used in C007.

references.title: Proofdoors and Efficiency of CDCL Solvers
references.note: Introduces structural decompositions that explain polynomial CDCL behavior on some families while retaining Resolution proof semantics, clarifying the boundary between tractable subclasses and universal claims.

claim_boundary: These primary sources support exact reductions and model boundaries. They do not prove the new H060-H069 conjectures.
